meta.name: Score real estate leads with Anthropic Claude and Google Sheets

name: AI Real Estate Lead Qualifier (rules-based scoring to Google Sheets)

parameters.content:
## AI Real Estate Lead Qualifier (rules-based scoring to Google Sheets)

### How it works

This workflow receives a new real estate lead through a webhook, normalizes the incoming contact and message fields, then uses an Anthropic-powered information extractor to structure the lead details. It applies an editable rules-based scoring matrix, logs the scored lead to Google Sheets, and returns the scored result in the webhook response.

### Setup steps

- Configure the webhook URL in the source system that submits new real estate leads.
- Set up Anthropic credentials for the chat model used by the information extractor.
- Review the Normalize input node mappings so incoming payload fields map correctly to mensaje, nombre, telefono, and canal.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials, select the target spreadsheet/sheet for lead logging, and set **Mapping Column Mode** to **Map Automatically** (selecting the sheet can reset it to manual, which causes a 'Values to Send' error).
- Test with sample leads and confirm the webhook response includes the expected scored lead data.

### Customization

Edit the scoring matrix code to adjust qualification rules, score weights, lead status labels, or required fields. You can also update the extraction schema/prompt if your lead messages contain different real estate criteria such as budget, location, property type, or buying timeline.

## Receive and normalize lead

Starts the workflow from an incoming webhook and standardizes the raw lead payload into the fields used downstream.

## Extract lead details

Uses the AI information extractor with the Anthropic chat model sub-node to parse structured lead information from the normalized message.

## Score the lead

Applies the editable rules-based scoring matrix to qualify and rank the extracted real estate lead data.

## Log and respond

Stores the scored lead in Google Sheets and sends the final scored lead data back through the webhook response.

options.systemPromptTemplate: =You are an information extraction engine for real estate lead inquiries written in any language. Today's date is {{ $now.format('yyyy-MM-dd') }}. Extract only facts stated in the message, normalizing shorthand: convert amounts like '900k' or '0.9M' into plain numbers (900000). Do NOT invent anything that is not stated: if budget, property type, bedrooms, area or visit availability are not mentioned, leave the field completely empty — never zero, never a placeholder like 'otro', never typical or example values. If the person explicitly says they do not have a clear budget yet, the budget field MUST be empty. Timelines: never compute month differences yourself. If the message states a duration ('in 6 months', 'in a year and a half'), fill plazo_meses only. If it states a calendar month, date or deadline ('in September', 'before October', 'by summer'), fill plazo_fecha only, as YYYY-MM, using today's date to pick the correct year (if that month is already fully over this year, use next year). Traveling to the area to view properties counts as visit availability; a relocation or moving date does not — it is a timeline.

attributes.name: intencion
attributes.description: Lead intent. One of: 'comprar', 'vender', 'alquilar', 'invertir', 'otro'. Infer from context (e.g. asking about a listed property usually means 'comprar').

attributes.name: zona
attributes.description: Area, neighbourhood or city the person is interested in, exactly as mentioned (e.g. 'Marbella Este').

attributes.name: tipologia
attributes.description: Property type mentioned: apartamento, piso, ático, villa, casa, chalet, adosado, etc.

attributes.name: dormitorios
attributes.description: Number of bedrooms requested, if mentioned.

attributes.name: presupuesto
attributes.description: Maximum budget in euros as a plain number (e.g. 650000). If a range is given, use the upper bound. Convert '650k' or '0.9M' to full numbers.

attributes.name: plazo_meses
attributes.description: ONLY when the message states a relative duration ('in 6 months', 'in a year and a half' -> 18). Plain number of months. Leave empty for calendar dates or deadlines — those go in plazo_fecha. Never compute this from a date.

attributes.name: plazo_fecha
attributes.description: ONLY when the message states a calendar month, date or deadline ('in September', 'before October'). Format YYYY-MM. Use today's date (in the system prompt) to pick the correct year. Leave empty for relative durations.

attributes.name: financiacion
attributes.description: One of: 'preparada' (mortgage approved or cash), 'necesita' (needs financing, not arranged), 'no necesita', 'sin datos'.

attributes.name: idioma
attributes.description: Likely preferred language of the lead based on the message (e.g. 'español', 'inglés', 'alemán', 'sueco').

attributes.name: disponibilidad_visita
attributes.description: true only if the person states availability or desire to visit / travel to see properties.
